title: cirsium tenoreanum
intro: Cirsium tenoreanum, commonly known as the mountain thistle, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The mountain thistle is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate digestive issues due to its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium tenoreanum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as bronchitis, fever, and skin conditions, attributed to its bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of the mountain thistle include sesquiterpene lactones (e.g., cnicin and tenoreanolide), phenolic acids (e.g., chlorogenic acid and caffeic acid), and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
